title: High-fidelity detection of IFN-? secreting CD4 and CD8 cells using ELISPOT and cell sorting
author: Aleksey Pichugin
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.jn4cmgw
materials: Stimulate part of DC cells dedicated to peptide antigen presentation with LPS (1 ug/ml). LPS Escherichia coli 055:B5(L-2880) Sigma 100ug/ml -80oC

steps.title: Prepare FACSAriaII Sorter
steps.instruction: Set up the FACSAriaII sorter for performance and aseptic sorting.

substeps.instruction: Install 70ul nozzle and check performance using CST protocol Cytometer Setup & Tracking Beads Kit (cat. 642412) with BD FACSDiva™ software v 6.x.
Set sorting parameters at 87 kHz and adjust drop creating and drop delay using AccuDrop beads (BD Biosciences cat. 345249).
Prepare the sorter for aseptic sorting according to the User Manual.

Place the spleen of one mouse into a 60 mm Petri dish containing 6 ml PBS-cell buffer (PBS [10 mM sodium phosphate, 137 mM sodium chloride, 2.7 mM potassium chloride], 1% glucose, 10 mM HEPES, 0.5% BSA, filtered 0.22 u).
Crush the spleen using the back side of a 5 ml syringe plunge and break up aggregates by intensive pipetting.
Layer 6 ml of the suspension over 4 ml of Ficoll-Paque solution (1.09 g/cm3) in a 15 ml centrifuge tube.
Centrifuge at 450 g and 18°C for 20 min with centrifuge brake rates set to zero.
Transfer the cell layer to a new 15 ml tube, add PBS-cell buffer up to 15 ml, and centrifuge for 10 min at 300 g and 4°C.
Discard supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 1 ml PBS-cyto buffer, breaking up aggregates by pipetting.

steps.title: Count and Adjust Splenocyte Concentration
steps.instruction: Determine cell concentration and viability using the AriaII.

substeps.instruction: Mix 10 ul of cell suspension with 200 ul PBS-count buffer (PBS [10 mM sodium phosphate, 137 mM sodium chloride, 2.7 mM potassium chloride], 10 mM HEPES, 0.5% BSA, 0.01% sodium azide, 0.35 mM EDTA, pH 7.4, filtered 0.22 u] supplemented with 1 ug/ml DAPI and Precision Count Beads™ [Biolegends cat. 424902 diluted 1:100]).
Vortex the suspension and buffer carefully before pipetting.
Run the sample on AriaII, stopping acquisition at 400 beads.
Set the lymphocytes gate within live (DAPI negative) events.
Calculate concentration and adjust splenocytes to 100 mln/ml in PBS-cell buffer.

steps.title: Stain and Sort CD4 and CD8 Cells
steps.instruction: Perform immunophenotyping and sorting of T cell subsets.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 0.6 ml of splenocytes to a 15 ml tube and add 2 ul each of CD19 FITC (clone 1D3, cat 552785), CD4 PerCP Cy5.5 (clone RM4-5, cat 550954), and CD8a APC (clone 53-6.7, cat 553035).
Vortex and incubate for 20 min in the dark at 4°C.
Add PBS-cell buffer up to 15 ml, centrifuge for 10 min at 300 g and 4°C, and discard supernatant.
Resuspend pellet in 3 ml PBS-cyto buffer, break up aggregates, add DAPI (1 ug/ml), and pass through a 40 um filter into a 4.5 ml tube.
Add 1 ml FBS to two 15 ml tubes and place them in the FACSAriaII 2-way sorting holder.
Acquire sample: exclude doublets (FSC-H vs. FSC-A), exclude dead cells (DAPI), and set lymphocyte size (FSC vs. SSC).
Gate CD4 as CD19- and CD8- negative events; gate CD8 as CD19- and CD4- negative events.
Sort using 'purity' precision and 'sweet spot' mode.
Stop sorting at desired counts, add PBS-cyto buffer up to 15 ml, and centrifuge for 10 min at 300 g and 4°C.
Discard supernatant and resuspend pellet in 1 ml DMEM-full (DMEM, 10% FCS, 2 mM L-glutamine, Non essential AA, 1 mM sodium pyruvate, 50 uM β-ME, 100 U/ml Pen Strep).
Count cells and adjust concentrations to 2 mln/ml for CD4 and 1 mln/ml for CD8 using DMEM-full.

steps.title: Generate Bone Marrow Dendritic Cells (BMDCs)
steps.instruction: Differentiate BMDCs from mouse bone marrow over 7 days.

substeps.instruction: Flush bone marrow from hind leg femurs of two 6-week-old female Balb/c mice using 2 ml PBS-cell buffer with a 25G x 1/2 needle into a 50-ml tube (perform 8 days before experiment start).
Add 20 ml PBS-cyto and centrifuge for 10 min at 300 g and 4°C.
Discard supernatant and lyse RBCs: add 9 ml sterile deionized water, wait 15 sec, then add 1 ml 10x HBSS and 20 ml PBS-cell buffer.
Centrifuge for 10 min at 300 g, resuspend in 1 ml PBS-cell buffer, count cells, and adjust to 10 x 10^6 cells/ml using DMEM-full.
Distribute 1 ml of cell suspension into four Petri dishes containing 9 ml DMEM-full (final density 1 x 10^6 cells/ml).
Add rmGM-CSF (from 4000 ng/ml stock) to a final concentration of 10 ng/ml, swirl, and incubate at 37°C, 5% CO2, and 95% humidity for 3 days.
On day 3, add 10 ml fresh DMEM-full and rmGM-CSF (final 10 ng/ml) and incubate for 4 additional days.
On day 7, harvest non-adhesive dendritic cells by careful washing with a serological pipette at the lowest speed (1 day before experiment start).
Transfer cells to two 50ml tubes, centrifuge at 300g for 10 min, resuspend each in 1 ml PBS-cell buffer, and combine.
Estimate purity and viability via flow cytometry and adjust concentration to 1 mln/ml with DMEM-full.

steps.title: Transduce and Prepare BMDCs
steps.instruction: Transduce BMDCs with Adenoviral vectors and prepare for ELISPOT.

substeps.instruction: Dispense 3.5 ml cell suspension into five 60-mm Petri dishes labeled: DC, DC-LPS, DC-Ad5-tet-M2, DC-Ad5-tet-NP, and DC-Ad5-null.
Add Ad5 (100 pfu/cell) to the respective dishes: Ad5-null (10E8 PFU/ml), Ad5-tet-M2 (6*10E9 PFU/ml), and Ad5-tet-NP (7*10E9 PFU/ml).
Incubate overnight at 37°C, 5% CO2, and 95% humidity.
Harvest non-adherent BMDCs by gentle pipetting with culture medium, transfer to 15 ml tubes, add 10 ml PBS-cell buffer, and centrifuge at 300g for 10 min.
Resuspend in 0.5 ml DMEM-full, count, and adjust concentration to 0.067 mln/ml with DMEM-full.
Divide 'DC-LPS' cells into three tubes: 'LPS', 'LPS-NP' (add recombinant NP to 5 μg/ml), and 'LPS-M2' (add M2e peptide to 50 μg/ml).

steps.title: Perform IFN-γ ELISPOT Assay
steps.instruction: Measure IFN-γ secretion using an ELISPOT kit.

substeps.instruction: Dispense 150 ul (10,000 cells) of each DC type into wells of an ELISPOT Mouse IFN-γ Kit (BD Biosciences cat. 552569) and let settle for 1 hour.
Add lymphocytes: 50 ul of unseparated spleen cells (10 mln/ml, 500,000 cells/well), or 50 ul of sorted CD4 (2 mln/ml, 100,000 cells/well), or 50 ul of sorted CD8 (1 mln/ml, 50,000 cells/well).
Incubate at 37°C, 5% CO2 in a horizontal position for 20 hours.
Aspirate suspension, wash wells 2x with DI water, and 3x with 200 µL Wash Buffer.
Add 100 µL Detection Antibody Solution, incubate 2 hr at room temperature, discard, and wash 3x with 200 µL Wash Buffer.
Add 100 µL Streptavidin-HRP Solution, incubate 1 hr at room temperature, discard, and wash 4x with 200 µL Wash Buffer.
Wash 2x with 200 µL PBS, add 100 µL AEC Substrate Solution, and monitor spot development for 5–25 minutes.
Stop reaction with DI water and air-dry overnight at room temperature.
Image wells using a binocular microscope MBS-10 (x32) and Levenhuk DCM800 camera; quantify spots using ImageJ.

steps.title: Analyze T Cell Activation via Flow Cytometry
steps.instruction: Perform intracellular cytokine staining for IFN-γ and surface marker analysis.

substeps.instruction: Adjust transduced DC concentrations to 0.1 mln/ml with DMEM-full and place 1 ml (100,000 cells) per well in a 24-well Nunclon plate.
Adjust experimental splenocytes to 50 mln/ml in PBS-cell buffer and add 100 μl (5 million cells) to each DC well.
Incubate in CO2-incubator for 12 hours, then add brefeldin-A to a final concentration of 5 μg/ml (BioLegend cat. 420601).
After 6 hours, add 2 ml cold PBS-cyto buffer to wells, pipette cells into 4.5 mm tubes, and centrifuge (300g/10min/4°C).
Discard supernatant, resuspend in 1 ml PBS-cyto buffer, transfer to 1.2 ml microtube, and centrifuge again (300g/10min/4°C).
Discard supernatant and add 50 ul antibody mixture in PBS-cyto buffer: CD4 PerCP Cy5.5 (1:200), CD8 Alexa Fluor 700 (1:100), CD44 PE-Cy7 (1:200), and CD62L Alexa Fluor 488 (1:200).
Incubate 20 min in the dark at 4°C, add 1 ml PBS-cyto buffer, centrifuge (300g/10min/4°C), and discard supernatant.
Vortex the pellet and add 100 μl FixPerm solution (BD CytStirreofix/Cytoperm™ 554722).
Incubate 20 min at 4°C in the dark, wash twice with 0.5 ml PermWash solution (300g/10min/4°C), and resuspend in 50 ul PermWash solution.
Divide into two 20 ul aliquots: add 20 μl Anti-Mouse IFN-γ PE (1:10 in PermWash, cat. 554412) to one, and 20 μl isotype antibody PE Rat IgG1, κ (1:10 in PermWash, 554685) to the other.
Vortex and incubate at 4°C for 30 min in the dark, wash twice with 0.5 ml PermWash (300g/10min/4°C), and resuspend in 300 ul PBS-cyto buffer.
Acquire at least 1 million events using FACSAriaII.
